entries.title: The unanswered-message notice says what the app saw
entries.body: When the app cannot tell that your first mate answered a message, its notice now says your first mate may have missed it, rather than that it has not answered. Your message stands out in a highlighted quote with the time you sent it, one line says what the app saw, such as a card your first mate closed before you chose, and the notice speaks your language.

picture.alt: The notice titled Your first mate may have missed your message, with the message in a highlighted quote labelled with its time, a reason line, and Leave it and Ask again buttons.
